name: ass-tracker
description: ICT Asset Tracker — cloud-ready inventory for ICT teams

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev --prefix apps/api" "npm run dev --prefix apps/web"
scripts.dev:lan: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev --prefix apps/api" "npm run dev --prefix apps/web -- --host"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix apps/api && npm install --prefix apps/web
scripts.build: npm run install:all && npm run build --prefix apps/web
